channel.title: Business Insider Nederland - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Business Insider Nederland (businessinsider.nl)

item.title: Fortune 100 companies are back in the office — but 'work from home dark matter' is thriving under the radar
item.description: Remote work endures despite stricter RTO policies at Fortune 100 companies, as managers give the nod for more flexible arrangements.

item.title: I've worked at Google, Amazon, and Salesforce. Here's how to prep for an interview in the AI era, no matter your experience level.
item.description: Akaash Vishal Hazarika, a senior software engineer, explains how AI integration and prompt engineering are changing hiring in Big Tech software roles.

item.title: Palmer Luckey says Meta's VR layoffs aren't a 'disaster' — and fix a problem critics aren't talking about
item.description: Oculus founder Palmer Luckey said Meta's VR cuts targeted subsidized game studios that were crowding out developers and distorting the industry.

item.title: WNBA star Cameron Brink shares her favorite high-protein breakfast to build muscle and boost recovery
item.description: Los Angeles Sparks athlete Cameron Brink said she prioritizes building muscle with a high-protein breakfast that includes plenty of carbs for energy.

item.title: She was a first-generation college grad. Now, she has $55,000 in student loans and is postponing having kids.
item.description: Eryn Bostwick said that her high student-loan payments have prevented her from moving forward with IVF treatment.

item.title: Some flight attendants at ultra-low-cost carriers make more than United crew. Here's how much they earn.
item.description: United's roughly 28,000 flight attendants haven't seen a raise since 2020. Allegiant's new contract has now outpaced United at almost every level.

item.title: America's new sink-or-swim era is here
item.description: Capitalism is alive and well in the private sector, where many employers have higher expectations and care less about loyalty.

item.title: Lego and Pokémon released a $650 collab, and resellers are already vying to get a bite of the market
item.description: Lego released its first-ever Pokémon-themed sets last week. Within hours of preorders opening, scalpers had moved in.

item.title: 3 watch predictions for 2026 that reveal what buyers want next
item.description: Luxury watch trends for 2026 could include Cartier rising in popularity among buyers and smaller dial sizes gaining ground.

item.title: The Supreme Court is about to weigh in on the Fed's independence in a case that goes beyond Jerome Powell
item.description: The Fed's independence is being tested. Here's what SCOTUS justices could say on Wednesday about Trump's efforts to fire Fed board member Lisa Cook.
